Apartamenti eshte nje mundesi ideale banimi dhe investimi pasi kompleksi ofron shume fasilitete te ndryshme.
Per me shume informacion ose shoqerim ne prone lutemi te na kontaktoni.

description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN PORTA TIRANA E RE On the Tirana - Teg highway in the residential complex "Porta Tirana e Re" 1+1 apartment is offered for sale. The apartment is spacious with total 85 m2 is located on the second floor in a building of 2026 towards completion. The organization of the apartment is divided into: corridor, bedroom, living room with kitchen, toilet, two balconies. The apartment is an ideal housing and investment opportunity as the complex offers many different facilities. For more information or assistance in the property, please contact us.
